summary: Frontend-only verification of GitHub Pages subpath fix for JawyXdevs portfolio. Verified (1) production build via `CI=false yarn build` succeeds and emits RELATIVE asset paths (./static/js/main.089244d9.js, ./static/css/main.170fc8fe.css), (2) served the build under a /jawyXdevs-porfolio/ subpath via python http.server — index.html, JS bundle, CSS bundle, /assets/hero-chrome.png, and /projects/*.jpg all return HTTP 200, (3) preview app at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL loads fully: preloader plays, hero reveals with JAWYXDEVS heading, all 4 nav links present, contact-button present, hero-chrome.png naturalWidth=1024, marquee images load (naturalWidth=1280), all 6 project cards render with correct Live Project hrefs (barbershopkwc.com, cambriancustompainting.com, tigar.ca, bxc-pied.vercel.app, fadedistrictcuts.com/www subdomain, snowbrosptbo.ca) and target=_blank, 18/18 project images loaded after scroll, 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: package.json homepage='.' correctly emits relative paths; build output verified subpath-safe.
All public asset references correctly use process.env.PUBLIC_URL prefix in HeroSection, MarqueeSection, ProjectsSection.
GitHub Actions workflow /app/.github/workflows/deploy.yml exists — cannot verify actual GH Pages deploy from here; user must push and enable Pages > Source: GitHub Actions.
Note: fadedistrictcuts.com Live Project href resolves to https://www.fadedistrictcuts.com/ (www subdomain) — matches user expectation semantically. All target=_blank as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production build already verified subpath-safe. Preview URL fully functional. GitHub Pages actual deploy requires user push + enabling Pages source=GitHub Actions; not testable from here.
rca of the issue: Original bug: GH Pages served Jekyll-rendered README because no built app was deployed, and CRA default absolute asset paths (/static/...) would 404 under /jawyXdevs-porfolio/ subpath. Fix (verified working): homepage='.' → relative ./static paths; PUBLIC_URL prefix on public-folder image srcs; deploy.yml workflow to build and publish frontend/build via actions/deploy-pages. Confirmed by serving build under nested subpath dir and getting HTTP 200 on all bundled + public assets.
